# Copilot Instructions

Context file for Claude Sonnet 4.6 to understand yantraverse architecture.

## Project Overview

yantraverse is a lightweight Node.js web framework with:
- Fast routing with pattern matching
- Middleware support
- Static file serving
- Built-in security (helmet)
- CORS support
- Rate limiting

## Key Files

- `src/index.js` - Core app engine
- `src/router.js` - Route pattern matching
- `src/static.js` - Static file server
- `src/middleware/` - Middleware implementations
